UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Stores user profile, subscription plan tier (BASIC, PRO, MAX), and theme preference.

userId.description: The authenticated Firebase UID of the user.

promoCodeUsed.description: Optional promotional/developer code redeemed by the user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when account record was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when account record was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

CloudCourse.title: CloudCourse
CloudCourse.description: Stores a user's generated course curriculum, offline lessons bundle, and quiz/lesson progress.

completedLessonsJson.description: Serialized list of completed lesson IDs.

offlineLessonsJson.description: Serialized map of offline cached lesson contents.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when course was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when course was updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

DailyStreak.title: DailyStreak
DailyStreak.description: Tracks consecutive days of learning activity, longest streak, XP, weekly day activity, and streak freeze shields in Firestore.

currentStreak.description: Current consecutive days of learning activity.

lastStudyEpochDay.description: UTC epoch day of the most recent recorded learning activity.

totalXp.description: Cumulative XP earned across lessons, flashcards, and drills.

streakFreezeActive.description: Whether the streak freeze shield is currently active.

streakFreezesAvailable.description: Number of remaining streak freeze shields.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when streak record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when streak record was last updated.

UserBadge.title: UserBadge
UserBadge.description: Stores user learning achievements, milestone unlocks, and progress in Firestore.

category.description: Milestone category (e.g. COURSE, STREAK, MARKET, CHESS, CODING).

isUnlocked.description: Whether the achievement has been unlocked.

unlockedAt.description: Epoch millisecond timestamp when badge was earned.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when badge was initialized.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when badge was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user account settings, plan tier, and profile metadata.

/users/{userId}/courses/{courseId}.description: Per-user synced courses, offline lesson packs, and completion progress.

/users/{userId}/streaks/{streakId}.description: Per-user daily learning streak record tracking consecutive days of activity.

/users/{userId}/badges/{badgeId}.description: Per-user unlocked achievements and learning milestone progress.
